notes.title: Released full version !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490214/fb1e79d5715d10a5b958a84d60f39ccadfff3e78.png[/img]

Hi, Good owners!

Thank you for enjoying the early access version until now.
From today's update, [Play Dog Play Tag] full version will be released.

[h1]Releasenote[/h1]

[h2]- Add breed[/h2]
8 new breeds have been added, allowing players to select their favorite dog from a total of 12 breeds.

[h2]- Add stage[/h2]
In addition to the basic stage “CITY”, two new stages “FARM” and “WASTELAND” have been added.
You can enjoy the battle on each characteristic stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490214/e7cd27f94ea5939005ff6f9f8d937ab8cadac4b1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490214/0f0500916b7e67cb01ac0c50375565cacaf1c4e7.png[/img]

[h2]- Full screen of "1P PLAY" screen[/h2]
When “1P PLAY” was selected in the battle mode, the 4-split screen was abolished and it became a full screen display.

[h2]- Training mode added[/h2]
Apart from the battle mode where you chase the thief and steal bones,
”Training mode“ ARENA ”stage that can be played by 2 to 4 people has been added.
Charge and shoot other players from the ring and hone your action skills.

[h2]- Add achievements[/h2]
 Various Steam achievements have been added.

[h2]- vsCOM Battle Adjustment[/h2]
A part of the vsCOM battle system has been adjusted.

[h2]- Price changes[/h2]
 The price has changed due to the addition of various elements.

[h2]- Bug fixes[/h2]
Fixed some minor bugs related to display and behavior.



Thank you for your evaluation and cooperation with the early access version.
Please enjoy the full release version in the future.

Team Pegasus

notes.title: Battle online with "Remote Play Together"!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490214/d7d890188ca68638d11b41f20e34bb68e8731f0b.png[/img]

A new Steam feature [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687]"Remote Play Together"[/url] has been released!
With this feature, all Steam users can enjoy local multiplayer games online.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490214/143b2eeb477af4d68ba4ec502642afb7dbcf8274.png[/img]

Of course, PLAY DOG PLAY TAG is also eligible for "Remote Play Together"!
Launch the game, select a friend from the friend list in the Steam overlay (Shift + Tab), and click "Remote Play Together".
Chase the bone thief while destroying the city together!

Since the function is still in the beta release stage, there may be a decline in image quality or lag depending on the specifications of the host PC, but there was no problem with game play.
Friends invited online also need a gamepad, but only the host player needs to add "PLAY DOG PLAY TAG" to the Steam library!

Enjoy a crazy dog walk with your best friends!


Team Pegasus
